title: Why people struggle to part with grandparents' belongings, says psychology

Identifying appropriate recipients can help assure these cherished items are used with respect rather than thrown away.

Legal actions include criminal charges and potential disciplinary measures against the officials involved in the case.

This agreement includes a contribution of $5 million towards the county's affordable housing initiatives. The decision comes after feedback from local leaders and the community regarding the proposed data centres.
